The '''Damask clan''' was a prominent [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] family of [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]]. In the last centuries of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Damask clan was involved with both the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]].<ref name="Star Wars: Darth Plagueis">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref>

The first known member of the clan was [[Hego Damask I|Hego]], clan father of [[Caar Damask]]. Caar was a member of long standing in the Banking Clan, who, both as a favor to [[High Officer]] [[Mals Tonith]] and in hopes of advancing a career that had stalled and kept him in middle management, became the administrator of [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] and its [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] [[Mining/Legends|mines]] at some point during the 9th century of the [[Great Peace of the Republic]] period. Ten years after his arrival on Mygeeto, Damask was manipulated into meeting his future [[Codicil partner|codicil]] [[Darth Plagueis's mother|wife]] by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Tenebrous]], also known as the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] Rugess Nome, who knew that their child would be very [[Force-sensitive/Legends|strong]] in the [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Tenebrous was correct&mdash;their son, the future [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Hego Damask]]&mdash;named after his grandfather&mdash;was born on [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] in due course. When Hego turned five, he was handed over to Nome, who took him as his apprentice and named him Darth Plagueis.<ref name="Star Wars: Darth Plagueis" />

Hego would later found a plasma mining company called Damask Holdings, which the Sith Lord used to further the [[Grand Plan/Legends|Sith imperative]]. Plagueis claimed, in [[65 BBY/Legends|65 BBY]], that he killed all his relatives, leaving him the sole heir to the Damask fortune. The Damask family apparently died off in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], when Plagueis's apprentice, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], murdered his master in [[Darth Plagueis' apartment/Legends|his apartment]].<ref name="Star Wars: Darth Plagueis" />
